summary: Purple Biotech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, attaching a press release reporting first-quarter 2026 financial results and business highlights. The filing contains routine quarterly earnings disclosure, including a cash position of $6.4 million and operational updates on its CAPTN-3 platform and IM1240 tri-specific antibody. There are no terms of a transaction, no shareholder vote, no board recommendation, and no special-situation event such as acquisitions, divestitures, bankruptcies, or management changes. This is a standard foreign private issuer earnings report, not a special situation.
